Reviewed my own #4774 fix-round edits against the code: createStationConfinementPreflight (confinement-preflight.ts) uses inheritedSpawnEnv and createCredentialProfileAppHomeEnvPeek, so no app-home profile or spawn TMPDIR is created, while loadConnectionSettings/connectionLaunch are the runtime's configLoader.loadAppConfig, whose loadAppConfigFileInternal writes a default config/app.json when missing and persists legacy-key migrations; probeSeatbelt runs spawnSync with timeout 10_000 and createSeatbeltConfinementProvider caches the result on the shared provider in DEFAULT_CONFINEMENT_PROVIDERS, which OrchestrationService also uses. locateAppHomeProfile now refuses a missing profile whose path or an ancestor is not a directory or whose parent is not writable, and claudeConfinedCredentialPreflight maps the resulting CredentialProfileEnvironmentError to unverified, which doctor shows as Not verified. stripTerminalControls now turns a run of tab/line/page breaks between words into one space. The paragraph and the row text match.

Reviewed my own #4774 fix-round edit to the GET /api/diagnostics/confinement-preflight entry against the code: no app-home profile or spawn TMPDIR is created (inheritedSpawnEnv, createCredentialProfileAppHomeEnvPeek); the connection settings come from configLoader.loadAppConfig, whose loadAppConfigFileInternal saves a default config/app.json when none exists and persists legacy-key migrations (shouldPersist); probeSeatbelt is a spawnSync with a 10 s timeout in a removed mkdtemp directory, cached per provider instance (the shared DEFAULT_CONFINEMENT_PROVIDERS a start also resolves from), a failure included. No ConfigLoader entry point reads without creating or migrating, so the text states the write instead of avoiding it.
